config.conditions: Warm local production builds; source SHA verified on /health; immutable asset headers enabled; fresh browser contexts or Chrome processes per sample.

caveats: Optimized local builds. Warm Worker processes, fresh browser contexts per round.
Click time starts in the browser click handler and ends at the first animation frame with the destination marker visible. This is DOM/style readiness, not physical paint.
CDP latency is a minimum request latency, not a complete mobile network model.
No cookies, headers, query strings or response bodies are retained.
note: Repeated cumulative per-step ResourceTiming arrays omitted. Full raw runs are retained in the local archive. Initial resources and per-step requests are preserved.
